answer: AI agents store and save information between sessions by using Markdown files to record data [2]. These files, often named “memory.md”, are written to a folder where the Orpo is installed [2]. The agent retrieves and modifies these files to restore its persona and context in subsequent sessions [2]. Changes made to these files are visible to the user [2]. The model incorporates information from these saved “memories” to inform its predictions and actions [1].
